prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Palladium (팔라듐) itself — the sovereign of the Palladium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: palladium: a soft silver-white metal that never tarnishes, named for the asteroid Pallas, found the year before and itself named for Pallas Athena, goddess of wisdom; in 1803 it was first offered anonymously as a new silver in a small London shop, with a reward promised to anyone who could make it themselves; at room temperature it soaks up hydrogen like a sponge, up to nine hundred times its own volume, and a thin palladium sheet lets only hydrogen pass through; it cleans car exhaust as a catalyst and whitens gold. Palette: soft silver-white, owl-feather dove grey, olive green, pale hydrogen blue, storm grey.

World (fixed): a walled citadel city guarded by a small carved statue of its goddess kept in a high shrine, for the city cannot fall while it stands: pale ramparts above silvery olive groves where owls nest, a fountain of silver-white stone that silently drinks in the morning mist. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 2) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 3) large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape; 4) thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette; 5) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 6) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette; 7) a great crown and a fur-trimmed royal mantle over an ornate breastplate — a ceremonial, regal silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): soft silver-white, owl-feather dove grey, olive green, pale hydrogen blue, storm grey.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): soft silver-white hair banded with warm dove grey like owl feathers. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Render this detailed design in one image. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Pd) and atomic number (46) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

DETAILED ORIGINAL DESIGN:
Choose silhouette 5: a long commanding officer coat below the knees with epaulettes, belt and tall boots, high-fantasy materials only. An adult woman with fair lightly freckled skin, blue-grey almond eyes, softly square jaw and subtle rose lips, long banded silver-white and dove-grey hair braided over one shoulder, parted fringe. A small knowing smile, front-facing face, one foot advanced, both empty hands visible. Signature construction: the silver-white coat mantle has interlocking owl-feather-shaped folded pleats that open and close like a breathing sponge, olive velvet interior and pale blue gem joints, all medieval enchanted textile and metal rather than machinery. Deep open neckline, bare arms, slit coat panels showing thigh with opaque inner coverage. She walks along pale citadel ramparts above the olive groves, daylight, whole figure framed with margins.
